task:
Fine-map loci of the study eadb2026 (shared inputs in prep/eadb2026).
Choose your own methods, reference panel, QC and parameters, and record every choice that could change the results.
Write the standard result tables (configs.tsv, pip.tsv, cs.tsv) with a pip.tsv row for every variant you fine-map (not only credible-set members), and check them with tools/check_outputs.py.
Be economical: plan before acting, batch work into a few scripts, do not re-read files you have seen, keep messages short, and give a final reply of under 150 words (what you did, key credible sets, caveats).

panel.ukb: Use the PolyFun UK Biobank LD panel (ukb_hg19) as your LD panel.
panel.panukb: Use the Pan-UKBB EUR LD panel (panukb_hg19_EUR) as your LD panel.

ambiguous.drop: Drop all strand-ambiguous (A/T and C/G) SNPs.
ambiguous.keep_resolved: Keep strand-ambiguous SNPs whose allele frequency resolves the strand against the panel, and drop the rest.
